ls.security.title: Zero-Trust Local Privacy
ls.security.desc: Your private journals belong only to your device. Even we cannot access them.
ls.security.card1.title: 100% On-Device
ls.security.card1.desc: All entries are saved in your device's isolated storage, never transmitted to external servers, eliminating data leaks.
ls.security.card2.title: Military-Grade SQLCipher
ls.security.card2.desc: Encrypts the entire SQLite database using AES-256. Even if your device is lost, your data remains unreadable.
ls.security.card3.title: Secure Private Backup
ls.security.card3.desc: Optionally sync to your personal iCloud or Google Drive. Backups are double-encrypted with your private key before upload.
ls.insights.title: Discover Yourself Through Data
ls.insights.desc: Just write. Our mood calendar maps and weekly insights will visualize your mental journey.

ls.insights.card3.title: Weekly Insights
ls.insights.card3.desc: Get statistics on your logs, including total entries, photos, and links, allowing you to reflect on your journaling habits.

fs.impact.title: Smart Scanning & Easy Registration
fs.impact.desc: Easily register ingredients using camera date scanning and barcode recognition. Fill your pantry without typing.
fs.impact.card1.title: Expiry Date Camera Scan
fs.impact.card1.desc: Simply point your camera at the expiration date, and it will automatically analyze and enter the date for you.
fs.impact.card2.title: Barcode Database Lookup
fs.impact.card2.desc: When you register a barcoded item, the app automatically learns and stores the product name, auto-filling it next time.
fs.impact.card3.title: Quick Batch Actions
fs.impact.card3.desc: Register multiple items at once and quickly change storage locations or status with simple gestures.
fs.push.title: Scheduled Summary Notifications
fs.push.desc: Never miss an expiration date. We gather all expiring items and send a clean, scheduled summary push notification at your preferred time (e.g., 9:00 AM).

bs.mentors_dialogue.nightingale: I attribute my success to this: I never gave or took an excuse.
bs.mentors_dialogue.einstein: Imagination is more important than knowledge. For knowledge is limited, whereas imagination embraces the entire world.
